screened nuclear repulsion below r_outer. Everything else is unchanged;
see examples/01-bulk for the meaning of the other values.

_comment_type_map: The whole periodic table, indexed so that a type IS the atomic
number: hydrogen 1, oxygen 8. Index 0 is ASE's dummy "X", never
assigned to an atom -- the price of indices being the numbers you
already know. scripts/xyz_to_deepmd.py writes this by default, so
this list and every dataset's type_map.raw are the same list.
Only H and O appear in this data. The other 116 types simply never
receive a gradient; they cost a row each in the type embedding and the
energy bias, and nothing else. What they buy is that this model and
this dataset are not welded to each other: either can meet another
DeePMD-kit refuses any element a system's type_map.raw has and this
list does not, so shortening this means re-converting with

_comment: rcut must stay below half the cell length (12.429/2 = 6.21 A), or an
atom sees two images of the same neighbour. 6.0 is inside that, but
only just -- a smaller cell would need a smaller rcut.
Full ZBL below r_inner, zero above r_outer, a quintic switch
between. Water's closest pair in this data is 0.93 A and the O-H
bond 0.97 A, so r_outer must sit below the bond: at 0.8 A the
term shapes only the collision wall the data never samples.
Choose the radii for YOUR system -- the defaults are not
calibrated for anything.
The charge head predicts a per-atom charge from the SAME descriptor
features the energy head reads, so the backbone runs once. Charges are
projected to the frame's total charge (0 here), which is what keeps
the reciprocal sum convergent.
alpha 0.4 pairs with rcut 6.0: erfc(0.4*6) = 7e-4, so the part left
to the network has died inside its own cutoff.
mesh spacing must beat 1/(2*alpha) = 1.25 A, so ceil(12.429/1.25) = 10.
Fixed dimensions, NOT mesh_spacing: a spacing-derived mesh is a step
function of the cell and makes the energy discontinuous under strain.
3D-periodic bulk, so no slab correction and no open axis.
Forces dominate the objective: there are 3*natoms of them per frame
against one energy, and they carry the local information the descriptor
must learn. start_pref_v 0 -- these labels have no virial.
